caption: The drawing depicts a single dress composed of a fitted bodice and a full, long skirt. The dress is rendered using a mix of purple, blue, and pink watercolor shades that create a sense of depth and shine in the fabric. The bodice has a broad collar that extends over the shoulders and is decorated with a trim of blue fringe that runs along its edge and across the chest. The long sleeves are slightly puffed and end in cuffs, also trimmed with fringe. A second line of the same blue fringe encircles the waist, where the bodice meets the skirt, and another line adorns the edge of the skirt at the hip. The skirt is voluminous and falls to the floor, with color shifts indicating light and shadow. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller, uncolored line drawing of the same dress showing its outline and detailing, including the placement of the fringe trim. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color.
title: Gown
